about: X1: hover with no machine (G-code system A detected). column is 1-based, on the first character of the word.

hovers.markdown:
**G71** — Roughing cycle along Z

Roughs an outside or inside contour in passes along Z and leaves a finishing allowance for G70\. Written in two blocks: the depth of cut and the retract first, then the profile range, the allowances and the feed\. The block with P and Q runs the cycle; the same U means the depth of cut in the first block and the allowance on X in the second\. The first block's values are machine parameters that the block overwrites, so they stay in force until written again\. The addresses are those of the usual ZX plane \(G18\); in another plane the control reads other ones\.

_Cycle_

**G76** — Multi\-pass threading cycle

Cuts a thread in several passes, taking less material each time\. Written in two blocks: the finishing passes, the pull\-out chamfer and the insert angle packed into P, the smallest depth of cut and the finishing allowance first; then the end point, the taper, the thread height, the depth of the first cut and the lead\. The block with X \(U\) and Z \(W\) runs the cycle; P, Q and R mean different things in the two blocks, and each of them stays in force until it is written again\. F is the thread lead per revolution, not a feed rate\. gEdit shows both P values as written: the packed digits of the first block must never be converted\.

The feed carries the thread pitch here, so changing it changes the thread\.

_Cycle_

Required: F

**X** — X axis, a diameter

Position across the turning axis, written as a diameter while diameter programming is on\. With G4 it is a dwell time in seconds\.

**U** — Incremental X, a diameter

Distance to move across the turning axis, as a diameter\. Inside the multi\-pass cycles it is a depth of cut or an allowance on X instead, and with G4 a dwell time in seconds\.
